body.message:
Hello,

The FLAM Living Wi-Fi was working perfectly before, and our TV was connected to Netflix without any issues.

Now, the same Wi-Fi network provided with the apartment is no longer working. Even the router/modem shows a red light, which indicates there is a problem.

Could you please send someone immediately to fix this? We can no longer watch Netflix, use the TV, or work because the internet is not functioning.

Thank you for your understanding, and we would appreciate your urgent assistance.
